canny.scope: Isolated complete bounded-frame GRAY8 Canny self-test, MAX8x8; Gaussian/Sobel L1/Q8 four-direction NMS/dual thresholds/repeated 8-connected hysteresis, including nine-hop weak chain. Ten commands, 272 real inputs/outputs, four expected command errors; CE13/16, output/response backpressure and config perturbation. Actual50MHz, original fixed272-pixel golden digest7C514D90 and 46-byte UART. Four extra registered Sobel enabled stages per pixel; not continuous video, larger-frame or arbitrary-parameter signoff.

dehaze_dcp.scope: Isolated complete RGB888 DCP bounded-frame self-test, MAX3x3, MAX_RADIUS1: real RGB input, dark channel, same-frame auto/manual airlight, channel normalization, Q15 transmission, real optional guided refinement, signed saturated recovery and replay. Ten commands, 41 real inputs/outputs, four expected errors; two actual guided frames, CE1/4, backpressure and command snapshot checks. Actual50MHz, unchanged digest5512B18B and 51 UART bytes. No larger-frame, continuous-video or FPS signoff.

guided_refine.scope: Bounded guided-refine stage, not complete dehaze pipeline: four fixed grayscale-guide/Q1.15 transmission frames, 400 output pixels, radius/epsilon cases, edge replication, synchronous coefficient RAM, CE4 and output/response backpressure; exact Python pixel checks and 160 UART bytes. No continuous-video, arbitrary frame-size or default-parameter signoff.

window_filter8.scope: Bounded end-to-end frame/window plus eight filters: five GRAY8 frames, 206 pixels, 102 valid-crop windows, max 9x8; all nine taps, coordinates/markers and independent sink backpressure checked against Python fixtures. Real 50 MHz; CE is enabled for 13 of each 16 clocks (disabled phases 5,6,7). No padding or full-video throughput signoff.

geometry.scope: Isolated grayscale8 frame geometry, MAX_WIDTH=4, MAX_HEIGHT=3. 14 commands, 168 inputs, 182 outputs and 2 expected error responses. Nearest/bilinear geometry with scale, rotation, mirror, affine and external perspective mapping; CE/backpressure/reset/error recovery. Actual 50MHz/CE13/16, no timing exception; no larger-frame timing or continuous-video throughput signoff.

multiframe.scope: Isolated MAX4x3 RGB888 multiframe application self-test: real dual-frame BRAM store, OSD key/alpha, absolute difference, persistent Q8.8 EWMA background update and weighted fusion. Thirty-eight commands, 88 main and 61 auxiliary inputs, 168 outputs, 60 actual background writebacks, 11 expected errors. Actual50MHz, CE13of16, original EDA58BD3 and 58 exact UART bytes. Includes read/copy wait states and three-stage elastic OSD/fusion arithmetic. No automatic stitching, larger frame or continuous-video throughput signoff.

stitch.scope: Isolated RGB888 4x3 registration/stitch chain, shift1, two ROI samples and nine ordered trials; 6x5 output canvas. 32 commands, 62 main/75 auxiliary inputs, 300 outputs and 14 expected errors. Luma SAD, first-min ties, confidence rejection, weighted composition, manual homography, framing errors and recovery. Actual 50MHz/CE1/4; no larger-frame timing or continuous-video throughput signoff.

bilateral.scope: Isolated GRAY8 bilateral 3x3 external-window kernel. Thirty-eight sigma configurations, 35 nine-tap windows and three expected errors; seven sigma pairs include Q8.8 values1 and65535. Shared iterative divider, registered weighted product and exact partial-product sigma squares; original766615F3 and43 exact UART bytes. Actual50MHz, CE13of16; no frame-window generation or continuous-video signoff.

temporal.scope: GRAY8 MAX4x3 isolated temporal-denoise self-test. Two real DUTs cover internal synchronous filtered-output history and external paired history. Thirty-two commands,207 main inputs/outputs,79 external-history pairs, 11 expected errors; original543453C2 and57 exact UART bytes. Motion-gated half-up Q8 blend, history invalidation and registered products. Actual50MHz,CE13of16; not default64x64 timing or video signoff.

isp_pointwise.scope: 188 output/marker checks and exact 210 bytes per run; actual 50MHz with CE4; not all ISP/full frontend qualification
